errata.was: no openly licensed machine-readable text of the recension exists in the searched corners; Berendts 1906 not among the scanned holdings
errata.now: Both witnesses were reachable under names the search did not use. Meshcherskii's 1958 edition is on the Internet Archive as item 1958_20250223 (uploaded February 2025). Berendts 1906 is bound in Texte und Untersuchungen 29 (item texteundunter28v29akad), not catalogued under his name. Both are seated in EA-CORPORA-37 (#1760), as 37/01 and 37/05.
errata.reason: The search stands as an accurate dated record of the corners it searched; this entry records where the witnesses were.

errata.locus: the contested pericope set; per-passage provenance
errata.was: the eight pericopes as defined by #1176 Appendix II, with paraphrases 'collated from Leeming & Leeming with Berendts and Meshcherskii consulted'
errata.now: The eight lines were the authors' station paraphrases of version 1.0 of The Word That Became Text, not a collation, and three of them have no witness. The seat's index now carries the eight passages Berendts printed (1906), with loci and Old Russian from the seated text. The paraphrases are kept as withdrawn and answered in the errata on #626.
errata.reason: Repaired in the seat on 2026-11-12; the seat's AXN was re-derived.

errata.now: The text layer is seated as EA-CORPORA-37 (#1760): the Old Russian of all seven books, the German of Books I–IV, the English of the twenty-two additions, and the first challengers. This seat stays the index of the eight.
